title: Breece Hall: I haven't always had ideal situations, but feel in position to really flourish

sources.title: Breece Hall: I haven't always had ideal situations, but feel in position to really flourish
sources.description: Jets running back Breece Hall's first four seasons set him up for the contract extension he signed this month, but he doesn't think that he's shown all he can offer in the NFL.
